title: Does it hold on a second model family?
question: Run the conditions behind the main claims on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with the same rules: do the results replicate?

config.rule: injection one layer after the selected refusal layer, fixed before the run (Llama: refusal 11, injection 12); strength 0.5 of the mean residual norm over non-outlier tokens (<= 5 x median): the same push as c = 0.5 on Llama, c = 0.115 of the raw mean on Qwen

headline: Qwen2.5 7B: ablating its refusal direction takes judged-harmful answers from 5.7% to 79.2%; the paired emotion vectors average 8.4% against 10.1% for random pushes (0 of 19 above random).

caveats: The planned c = 0.5 of the raw mean norm was run first and broke the answers: Qwen2.5's mean norm is lifted by massive activations on one newline token per prompt (13,700 against a median of 100), so the push was 2.2 times a typical token's norm. Flagged broken at c = 0.5: random 86.3%, paired emotion 98.7% (mean over conditions). Those files are kept as a separate set and not judged. The restated scale was chosen after inspecting this run and before any Qwen answer was judged, so the replication is at an adapted strength.
On Qwen 0 of 19 paired emotion vectors differ from no injection after Holm correction (smallest Holm p = 0.084), so the negative result rests on weaker evidence than on Llama.

Steering check at the main Qwen strength: without the calm vector the unsteered model names the injected emotion in 5.1% of benign answers (chance 5%), so the emotion is barely expressed at this strength.
Qwen2.5's chat template adds its default system prompt; every Qwen condition, including the baseline, has it.
One greedy run per condition; the random band uses 10 seeds on Qwen and 12 on Llama.
